subject: Pilot onboarding: PulsePay request for temporary no-PO onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@pulsepay.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — 6-week pilot onboarding (no PO?)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at PulsePay is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot integrating Redwood inference into our fraud-scoring flow. We're on a tight timeline and don't have a procurement cycle set up yet at PulsePay. Is there a way for you to onboard us as a vendor and allow the pilot to run without a formal PO? We can provide a signed pilot SOW and a W9; actual spend will be limited (estimated $5–8k).

If a PO is required, can we work through a temporary exception or pre-approved cap so we can get started this month? Attached: pulsepay_w9.pdf.

Appreciate any help —
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Integrations, PulsePay
jordan@pulsepay.co | (415) 555-0123

Hi Jordan — great to hear and glad the demo resonated. Short answer: our standard procurement requires a PO for vendor spend, but we do have a limited path for short pilots when spend is small and the right approvals are in place.

Next steps so we can move quickly:
- Please complete the Redwood vendor onboarding form (I attached the form).
- Confirm estimated pilot cap (you mentioned $5–8k).
- I'll loop in Procurement (Monica) and Sales Ops (Marissa) to review for a one-time exception.

Monica/Marissa — can you review PulsePay's W9 and the short pilot ask? If feasible, a temporary exception (no-PO onboarding) for spend up to $10k with quick finance sign-off would be ideal.

Jordan — thanks for sending the W9; attaching the vendor_onboarding_form for the team to fill.

Best,

Thanks Rishi — tagging this as a procurement intake. Monica here. Summary of policy and proposed path:

Policy baseline:
- Standard: PO required for vendor payments.
- Exceptions permitted for low-dollar pilots (< $10k) on a case-by-case basis with Finance approval and completed onboarding docs.

What I need from PulsePay to evaluate:
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (attached by Rishi).
2) W9 (received).
3) A named contact for invoicing (company + email).
4) Confirmation of pilot cap and anticipated billing cadence.

If PulsePay confirms <= $10k and provides the completed form, I can provisionally approve a no-PO onboarding for the pilot and issue a one-time vendor code. Finance (Laura) will need to sign off on the cap and the payables path (we will record a PO placeholder for tracking).

Jordan — can you fill out the attached form and confirm the $ cap and invoice contact? If everything looks good, expect a decision in 24–48 business hours once Finance reviews.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Why I recommend exception:
- Strategic: PulsePay is a likely expansion customer (sales cadence indicates 6–12 month runway).
- Low financial risk for a capped pilot ($7.5k).
- Quick time-to-value for the customer and better chance to close paid contract.

Request: Can Finance approve a one-time no-PO onboarding for PulsePay for up to $10k and confirm the accounting/AR workflow (how we'll capture invoices without a formal PO)? If approved, Procurement will assign vendor code and Sales Ops will update HubSpot.

Forwarded message follows.

Team — I've reviewed the packet (W9, completed onboarding form, pilot cap request). Finance approves a one-time PO exception for PulsePay under the following conditions:

1) Pilot spend is capped at $10,000 total. Any forecast above that requires a standard PO and review.
2) Procurement will provision a temporary vendor code: PE-2026-117. Use this code on any internal records.
3) Sales Ops (Marissa) must log the pilot and attach the vendor code and the signed pilot SOW to the HubSpot company record (link preferred).
4) PulsePay invoices should be sent to ap@redwood.ai with "PE-2026-117" in the invoice description. Finance will process without a PO under this provisional exception.

Marissa — please update HubSpot and confirm when done. Jordan — welcome aboard; please route invoices to ap@redwood.ai and include the code above. Procurement will follow up with a short vendor setup note and the purchase_order_placeholder.xlsx for our internal tracking.

I will mark this exception in our internal compliance log; Procurement and Sales Ops, please keep the records for audit.
